newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's upgrades Santos to Prime-2.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's upgrades Santos to Prime-2.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it has upgraded the commercial paper rating of Santos Ltd's Santos Finance Ltd to Prime-2 from Prime-3.
Outstandings under the paper programme total about A$550 million.

"Exploration and development of the Stag oil field offshore Western Australia and the Elang oil field in the Timor Sea have helped extend its oil reserve life index beyond eight years," Moody's said. It said Santos and partners have also signed up a significant number of new gas customers and volumes since 1995, aided by stronger natural gas demand - particularly in industry - new pipeline projects, and by deregulation of gas markets.

"Over the past three years, Santos' financial leverage has steadily declined as a result of stronger core earnings, cash flow in excess of internal capital spending, and debt reduction," Moody's said.
It said the balance sheet has also benefitted from higher earnings retention through a dividend retention programme that was suspended in 1996.

Moody's said Santos' goals to increase and diversify reserves indicated acquisitions would continue to be a risk factor. "Consequently, Santos' financial leverage is likely to incrase in the near-to-medium term," it said.

"However, Moody's believes that rising cash flow from new gas sales contracts and development projects, as well as a stronger equity base, will help mitigate the leveraging impacts of higher capital spending and acquisitions," it said.
"Moreover, management has indicated its comfort with gearing (net debt/equity) sustainable in the 50 percent area over the longer term," it said.
